blocks.text: MAKATI CITY — Philippine Veterans Bank has officially started the operations of the newly relocated Ayala Main Office Branch at the SSS Building along Ayala Avenue corner V.A. Rufino Street, Makati City on September 14. The new Ayala branch is the relocation of the Bank’s Makati branch previously situated at the Bank’s Head Office. The relocation is expected to provide greater accessibility and convenience to PVB clients in the Makati business district, while allowing the Bank to continue delivering its banking services in the area.
